parts.name: 2x4, 8 ft
parts.note: Home Depot: 2 in. x 4 in. x 96 in. #2 Premium Grade KD-HT Stud, $3.95, checked 2026-11-10. 2. Construction or #2 spruce/pine/fir, as straight as you can pick. Each board gives a wall, a beam, a crossmember and a 4-1/2 in bow block.

parts.name: 1x2 pine, 2 ft
parts.note: Home Depot: 1 in. x 2 in. x 8 ft. SSE KD Furring Strip Board, $1.27, checked 2026-11-10. Sold in 8 ft lengths; you need 2 ft. 1. Four 4-1/2 in keeper strips (stood on edge) and the 1-1/2 in slider spacer.

parts.name: 1x3 pine, 4 ft
parts.note: Home Depot: 1 in. x 3 in. x 8 ft. Premium Kiln-Dried Square Edge Whitewood Common Board, $3.84, checked 2026-11-10. Sold in 8 ft lengths; you need 4 ft. 1. Two 10 in elevation posts, the 4-3/4 in crank arm and the pawl post.

parts.name: 1x4 pine, 2 ft
parts.note: Home Depot: 1 in. x 4 in. x 6 ft. Common Board, $3.84, checked 2026-11-10. Sold in 6 ft lengths; you need 2 ft. 1. Two 5 in cheeks and the two 4-1/2 in bow caps.

parts.name: 3/4 in plywood project panel, 2 × 4 ft
parts.note: Home Depot: Sanded Plywood (Common: 23/32 in. x 2 ft. x 4 ft.), $25.00, checked 2026-11-10. 1. Sold as 3/4 in; it is really 23/32 in. The deck, four 8 in wheels, the pin wheel, the pawl and the latch.

parts.name: 3/8 in hardwood dowel, 36 in
parts.note: Home Depot: Waddell Hardwood Round Dowel, 36 in. x 0.375 in., $4.88, checked 2026-11-10. 2. Pins, crank handle, latch peg, six ratchet pegs and two stop pegs (40-3/4 in of pieces).

parts.name: 3/4 in hardwood dowel, 36 in (birch or oak)
parts.note: Home Depot: Waddell Birch Round Dowel, 36 in. x 0.75 in., $3.48, checked 2026-11-10. 1. The 11-5/8 in winch drum. Hardwood, not poplar.

parts.name: 5/16 in SOLID fibreglass driveway markers, 48 in, 12-pack (Home Depot SM5164O12)
parts.note: $28.99, checked 2026-11-10. Uses 4 markers, cut in half: eight 23-7/8 in rods, four stacked per arm. Buy solid only: some listings described as solid are hollow, so read the description and check a cut end.

parts.name: Clear vinyl tubing, 5/16 in ID × 7/16 in OD
parts.note: Home Depot: UDP 5/16 in. I.D. x 7/16 in. O.D. x 10 ft. Clear Vinyl Tubing, $5.02, checked 2026-11-10. 10 ft coil; buy two for about 20 ft. About 20 ft: eight 23-7/8 in sleeves and a 2 in crank-handle grip (16 ft 1 in used).

parts.name: Hose clamps that close down on a 1-3/4 × 7/16 in stack of four sleeved rods
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 3/4 - 1-3/4 in. Stainless Steel Hose Clamp 6720595, $2.48, checked 2026-11-10. Range 3/4 to 1-3/4 in fits the taped four-rod stack. 2, one per arm, 1-3/8 in from each tip. Check the range printed on the package before you buy.

parts.name: Electrical tape
parts.note: Home Depot: 3M Scotch Super 88 3/4 in. x 66 ft. Vinyl Electrical Tape, Black, $7.33, checked 2026-11-10. Tape bands round each stack, tip caps, a tape stop behind each hose clamp, and the knot tails.

parts.name: 2 mm UHMWPE braided cord, 100 ft, 1,000 lb (emma kites)
parts.note: $21.95, checked 2026-11-10. The bowstring is about 50 in nock to nock, about 58 in cut. Knots can slip: tape every tail.

parts.name: 3/8 × 3 in carriage bolts
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 3/8 in.-16 x 3 in. Galvanized Carriage Bolt, $1.63, checked 2026-11-10. 4, wheel axles.

parts.name: Flat washers for a 3/8 in bolt
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 3/8 in. Zinc Flat Washer (50-Pack), $6.87, checked 2026-11-10. 8, one on each side of each wheel.

parts.name: 3/8 in nylon-insert lock nuts
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 3/8 in.-16 Zinc Plated Nylon Lock Nut (10-Pack), $4.57, checked 2026-11-10. 4.

parts.name: 3 in butt hinges
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 2-Pack 3 in. Zinc Plated Non-Removable Pin Narrow Butt Door Hinge, $4.37, checked 2026-11-10. 1 pair, with their screws, to join the stock to the carriage.

parts.name: #8 × 1-1/4 in wood screws
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt #8 x 1-1/4 in. Star Drive Flat Head Interior Wood Screws (242-Pack), $11.98, checked 2026-11-10. About 40 (31 used, plus spares): deck to walls and bow blocks, posts, pawl post and slider.

parts.name: #8 × 2-1/2 in wood screws
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt #8 x 2-1/2 in. Zinc Plated Phillips Flat Head Wood Screw (4-Pack), $1.57, checked 2026-11-10. 10 (8 used, plus spares): two through each cap into each keeper strip.

parts.name: #8 × 3 in wood screws
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt #8 x 3 in. Zinc Plated Phillips Flat Head Wood Screw (2-Pack), $1.57, checked 2026-11-10. 20 (16 used, plus spares): carriage beams to crossmembers, and two down through each keeper strip into the bow block.

parts.name: #8 round-head screw, about 3/4 in
parts.note: 1, pawl pivot.

parts.name: 1/8 in braided nylon or mason line
parts.note: Home Depot: Everbilt 250 ft. White Nylon Mason Line Refill, $6.57, checked 2026-11-10. About 20 ft: the winch cord and a 6 ft pull cord.

parts.name: Exterior wood glue
parts.note: Home Depot: Titebond III 8 oz. Ultimate Wood Glue 1413, $7.49, checked 2026-11-10.

parts.name: Sandpaper, 80 and 120 grit
parts.note: Home Depot: 3M Pro Grade Precision 9 in. x 11 in. Medium 120-Grit Sheet Sandpaper (15-Pack), $14.98, checked 2026-11-10. 120 grit linked; buy 80 grit separately.

parts.name: Tennis balls
parts.note: Tennis balls only. No foam balls (too light for this bow, close to a dry-fire), nothing hard or pointed.

parts.name: Safety glasses
parts.note: Home Depot: Milwaukee Safety Glasses with Clear Fog-Free Lenses (4-Pack) 48-73-2012X4, $59.94, checked 2026-11-10. One pair for every person at the firing line, every session.

parts.name: Digital hanging (luggage) scale, Etekcity 110 lb
parts.note: $14.12, checked 2026-11-10. For the first-shot draw-weight test; any hanging scale that reads to 50 lb works.
